name: uberasm-flip-on-off-switch-every-x-frames
title: Flip On/Off Switch Every X Frames
description:
This is a simple LevelASM which makes it so that the on-off switch switches every X amount of frames (defaults to 60 frames = 1 second). The time between switches can be changed, along with some other customization options.

Uses two bytes of free RAM.

Requested by The_Uber_Camper.
